Origin and meaning

The name Brian has Irish roots and means “high, noble”.

About the name Brian

Brian Boru was a celebrated High King of Ireland in the early 11th century.

As a gift or a tattoo

People often order Brian as a framed gift or as a tattoo — the meaning, “high, noble”, is part of the appeal.
